All modules

drawers

sections · 0.1.1 · aj-s-drawers

Ask's History and Bookmarks (v4 C2): their pills (History; Bookmarks with the open day's count) and one dimmed modal layer holding both drawers, History from the left (exactly the title block and the rail on the desktop) and Bookmarks from the right, open together if wanted, each pill lit above the dim where no drawer covers it. History folds the days with chats: this week's past days one by one, weeks, months, years (weeks split at a month's end).

statedefaultyes: the two pills; the layer shut
statehoveryes: a history row or a bookmark takes a 7% --rule ground; the back link underlines; the pills carry their own
statefocus-visibleyes: the product's ring; opening a drawer focuses its Close
stateactiven/a: the pills carry their own press
statedisabledn/a: History and Bookmarks are always available
stateselectedyes: the open day's row in the destination's colours (--block-2 ground, a 3px --block mark); an open drawer's pill pressed
stateloadingn/a: the history and the bookmarks are known when the page draws
stateerrorn/a: nothing here can fail
stateemptyyes: a day without bookmarks says how to make one; no chats at all says so
